title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Implementation Plan for Further Strengthening the Work on the Construction of the People's Court Team and Grassroots Foundation
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the Implementation Plan for Further Strengthening the Basic-Level Foundation Work of Court Personnel Development

Fa [2018] No. 199

To the High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region; and all units of this Court:

To thoroughly implement the guiding principles of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, further strengthen the basic-level foundation work of court personnel development, and continuously improve the quality of law enforcement and case handling as well as judicial credibility, the Implementation Plan for Further Strengthening the Basic-Level Foundation Work of Court Personnel Development is hereby issued to you. Please earnestly implement it in light of actual conditions.

July 22, 2018

Implementation Plan for Further Strengthening the Basic-Level Foundation Work of Court Personnel Development

To earnestly implement the deployment requirements of the Party Leadership Group of the Supreme People's Court on "persisting in making basic-level foundation construction the top priority," further strengthen the basic-level foundation work of court personnel development, and continuously improve the quality of law enforcement and case handling as well as judicial credibility, the following implementation plan is formulated for relevant work.

I. Guiding Principles

Guided by Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, thoroughly implement the guiding principles of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the "Two Sessions" (National People's Congress and Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference), closely focus on the work goal of "striving to make the people feel fairness and justice in every judicial case," persist in making basic-level foundation construction the top priority, adhere to a problem-oriented and demand-oriented approach, focus on improving the political quality of court personnel, standardizing law enforcement and case handling behavior, enhancing judicial capability levels, alleviating the contradiction of "many cases but few personnel," and attracting and retaining trial talents, make great efforts to solve prominent issues affecting the development of basic-level court personnel, and strive to build a strong basic-level team that meets the requirements of court reform and development in the new era.

II. Main Measures

(1) Strengthen Political and Ideological Construction of the Basic-Level Team

1. Effectively strengthen the political construction of the basic-level people's court team. Educate and guide court personnel to deeply understand the political attribute of the people's court as a political and legal organ, unswervingly uphold the absolute leadership of the Communist Party of China over the work of the people's court, resolutely uphold General Secretary Xi Jinping's core position in the Party Central Committee and the entire Party, resolutely uphold the authority and centralized, unified leadership of the Party Central Committee, and ensure that they maintain a high degree of consistency with the Party Central Committee in political stance, political direction, political principles, and political path. Earnestly implement systems such as political rotation training and political supervision, guide court personnel to strictly abide by the Party's political discipline and political rules, and unswervingly implement the Party's line, principles, policies, and the decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee. Strictly implement the responsibility system for ideological work, resolutely resist the infiltration and influence of erroneous Western ideological trends, and enhance the firmness and consciousness of the majority of court personnel in taking the path of socialist rule of law with Chinese characteristics.

2. Deeply carry out study and education on Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era. Carry out centralized rotation training for leading cadres of basic-level people's courts, secretaries of grassroots Party organizations, and basic-level court personnel by classification and level. Generally offer specialized courses on studying Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era in various training sessions for basic-level court personnel, guiding the basic-level court team to raise their political stance, strengthen the "Four Consciousnesses," and firm up the "Four Confidences." The Supreme People's Court will hold 5 sessions of "Training Classes on Studying Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era and the Guiding Principles of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China," rotating training for about 1,000 presidents of basic-level people's courts and secretaries of grassroots Party organizations; high people's courts will do a good job in centralized training for other members of the leadership team of basic-level people's courts, comprehensively improving the ability of the leadership team of basic-level people's courts to steer the direction and lead the team.

3. Earnestly carry out the thematic education on "Remain true to our original aspiration and keep our mission firmly in mind." In accordance with the unified deployment of the Party Central Committee, combine it with the actual situation of the court to provide guidance, supervise and urge basic-level people's courts to solidly implement various tasks of the thematic education. Highlight the use of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era to arm the minds of court personnel, persist in combining centralized education with regular education, focus on solving prominent issues such as unsteady beliefs, unsolid purposes, weak sense of mission, and insufficient responsibility, and guide basic-level Party member court personnel to more consciously strive unremittingly for the historic mission of the Party in the new era. Earnestly implement the requirement for leading cadres to take the podium, carry out selection and recommendation of high-quality political education courses in conjunction with thematic education. Actively discover, select, and commend advanced models emerging in different positions, select and commend national outstanding courts, national outstanding judges, and national court case handling pacesetters, and encourage the majority of court personnel to take root at the grassroots level, contribute to the grassroots level, and make achievements at the grassroots level.

(2) Implement the Project to Enhance the Organizational Capability of Grassroots Party Organizations

1. Optimize the setting of grassroots Party organizations in basic-level people's courts. Strengthen work guidance and supervision and inspection, promote the establishment of a party committee or general Party branch in all eligible basic-level people's courts in various regions. According to the progress of the reform of internal institutions, adjust and improve the setting of Party organizations in basic-level people's courts, promote the establishment of Party groups in eligible trial teams or collegial panels, and extend the full coverage of Party organizations to the basic units of law enforcement and case handling. Continue to promote the separate establishment of Party branches in eligible people's tribunals, further expanding the coverage of grassroots Party organizations in people's tribunals. Implement the Opinions on the Term of Office of Grassroots Party Organizations to ensure the unified, standardized, and smooth transition of the term of office of Party organizations in basic-level people's courts. Establish a dynamic mechanism for the timely deployment and replenishment of Party member court personnel in people's tribunals, ensuring that each people's tribunal has at least one Party member at all times.

2. Strengthen the construction of the leadership team of grassroots Party organizations in basic-level people's courts. In conjunction with the reform of internal court institutions, select and properly strengthen the secretaries of grassroots Party organizations in basic-level people's courts, and appoint full-time or part-time deputy secretaries for Party branches with a large number of Party members. Carry out induction training and regular rotation training for secretaries of grassroots Party organizations, hold national demonstration training classes for secretaries of grassroots Party organizations in courts, set up online training courses for secretaries of grassroots Party organizations on the China Judge Training Network, and strengthen the training of Party affairs knowledge and performance ability of secretaries of grassroots Party organizations. Organize and guide basic-level people's courts to generally establish a list of responsibilities for secretaries of grassroots Party organizations, actively carry out annual述职评议 (job performance assessment) and assessment of secretaries of grassroots Party organizations, and transmit pressure to promote the implementation of work.

3. Carry out the standard-reaching activity for the construction of Party branches in basic-level people's courts. Earnestly implement the Regulations on the Work of Party Branches of the Communist Party of China, guide basic-level people's courts to formulate standards for the construction of Party branches according to local conditions, refine the work requirements of Party branches in all aspects, and use them as the basic basis and evaluation criteria for strengthening the construction of Party branches. Organize basic-level people's court Party branches to conduct self-examination and assessment against the standards, and actively rectify problems and gaps. The Party Leadership Group and the organ Party committee of the basic-level people's court should select a number of advanced Party branch models, help transform a number of backward Party branches, and drive the intermediate Party branches to strengthen and improve their work. Carry out the creation of "Party branch working methods" and the selection and promotion of innovative cases in Party building work, and promote the overall improvement of the work quality of Party branches.

(3) Improve the Standardization Level of Basic-Level Law Enforcement and Case Handling

1. Carry out a large-scale inspection of judicial standardization. Earnestly implement the deployment requirements of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission, carry out a large-scale inspection of judicial standardization, focus on basic-level people's courts, earnestly carry out special supervision of judicial style issues and judicial affairs supervision, further rectify problems of non-standard, unfair, uncivil, and non-rigorous judicial behavior, and severely punish judicial corruption. Strengthen the role of visual supervision of key nodes in the handling of enforcement cases, and focus on solving problems of irregular enforcement and illegal enforcement such as passive enforcement, delayed enforcement, selective enforcement, and arbitrary enforcement. Conduct special supervision on the implementation of the standardization construction of judicial police law enforcement. Timely report prominent issues found during inspection and supervision, and urge relevant courts to earnestly carry out rectification.

2. Carry out adjudicative document evaluation. Organize a national quality evaluation of adjudicative documents published online by courts, comprehensively use various evaluation methods, focus on conducting special evaluations of basic-level people's court cases involving remand for retrial, modification, reversal, order for retrial, long-term non-conclusion, petition complaints, and inconsistent adjudicative standards. Organize self-quality inspections and cross-evaluations of case quality, focus on identifying prominent issues in the adjudicative documents of basic-level people's courts in terms of document drafting norms, evidence analysis and fact finding, adjudicative reasoning and legal application, and adjudicative main text and substantive handling, timely report the evaluation situation, and continuously improve the adjudicative document verification mechanism.

3. Standardize trial and enforcement procedures. The Supreme People's Court will study and formulate procedural standards covering the main trial procedures and enforcement procedures in professional fields such as criminal, civil, administrative, and state compensation. High people's courts should improve the case flow and trial time limit management system focusing on trial and enforcement work, further standardize the case handling procedures of intermediate and basic-level people's courts within their jurisdiction in accordance with the trial and enforcement procedure flow standards of the Supreme People's Court, and comprehensively improve the standardization level of court trial and enforcement work. Earnestly carry out the work of publishing adjudicative documents and disclosing trial procedure information, focus on cases with great influence and high social concern, fully utilize forms such as live webcasting, video recording, and graphic live streaming to actively respond to social and online concerns about judicial cases. Rely on the China Trial Procedure Information Disclosure Network to carry out electronic service of documents, effectively improving the efficiency and standardization level of service of documents.

(4) Enhance the Judicial Capability Level of Basic-Level Judges

1. Increase the training intensity for basic-level judges. Complete the task of full rotation training for basic-level judges, and prepare for a new round of full rotation training. Utilize the training courses and materials on the China Judge Training Network to increase training efforts for basic-level judges. Organize national trial business experts and provincial trial business experts within their jurisdiction to give巡回授课 (itinerant lectures) at basic-level people's courts. According to the needs of trial and enforcement work, comprehensively adopt methods such as centralized off-the-job training, online video teaching, and itinerant lectures to strengthen training for basic-level judges on new laws, regulations, and judicial interpretations, information technology, and public opinion response skills, ensuring that each judge receives no less than 10 days of professional training per year.

2. Carry out job skills training activities. Closely combine with the actual work of trial and enforcement to extensively carry out job skills training and skill competitions for basic-level judges, judge assistants, clerks, and judicial police, transform rich and vivid trial practices into teaching resources, and effectively improve the performance ability of basic-level court personnel. High people's courts should organize a "Three One Hundred" evaluation activity targeting basic-level judges, including one hundred excellent adjudicative documents, one hundred excellent court hearings, and one hundred job experts, promoting learning through competition and comprehensively improving the judicial level of basic-level judges. Increase the intensity of initial training and specialized skills training for judicial police.

3. Improve the talent counterpart support mechanism. Strengthen support and assistance for the judicial capacity building of basic-level people's courts, promote the establishment of mechanisms for judges to engage in temporary training and exchange positions between upper and lower courts, between courts in eastern and western regions, and between courts in Beijing, Tianjin, and Hebei. The Supreme People's Court and courts in developed eastern regions will receive a certain number of judges from basic-level people's courts in western, poverty-stricken, and ethnic minority regions for temporary training, helping to improve the judicial capability and level of these basic-level judges. High people's courts regularly organize basic-level judges within their jurisdiction to study and exchange at higher-level courts and courts in developed regions of other provinces, organize basic-level people's courts in developed and underdeveloped regions within their jurisdiction to form "pairing" relationships for counterpart support, and promote basic-level judges to improve their trial ability through practice.

4. Deeply implement the "Thousand Talents Plan" for bilingual judges. Increase the training intensity for bilingual judges, in accordance with the Measures for the Evaluation of Bilingual Judges in Ethnic Minority Regions (Chinese and Ethnic Language), carry out the first batch of bilingual judge evaluations. Publish a series of books on bilingual judge ideological and political education, trial practice skills, judicial interpretations, and guiding cases. Cooperate with the National Ethnic Affairs Commission to research, develop, and promote bilingual intelligent translation and speech recognition technologies, expand the ethnic Chinese bilingual learning platform, and assist bilingual litigation work.

(5) Increase the Intensity of Personnel Supplementation for Basic-Level People's Courts

1. Promote the tilt of staffing resources and judge quotas towards the grassroots level. When distributing provincial-level political and legal special staffing, give priority to ensuring the needs of trial and enforcement work in basic-level people's courts in remote, poverty-stricken, and ethnic minority regions. Strengthen internal resource tapping, rationally use existing staffing resources, and promptly recruit and supplement needed personnel. Do a good job in the provincial-level overall planning of judge quotas, tilt the distribution of judge quotas towards the front line at the grassroots level, and establish a dynamic adjustment mechanism for judge quotas.

2. Promote the formulation of special personnel recruitment policies. Promote the implementation of the Opinions on Doing a Good Job in the Examination and Recruitment of Grassroots Civil Servants in Hard and Remote Areas, improve the provincial-level unified recruitment policy, when organizing provincial-level unified examinations for vacant positions in basic-level people's courts in remote, poverty-stricken, and ethnic minority regions, appropriately relax the examination opening ratio and academic requirements, and set aside an appropriate proportion of positions for recruiting bilingual personnel who are proficient in the local ethnic language. Promote the improvement of the unified national legal profession qualification examination policy, actively explore methods such as定向培养 (targeted training) and joint training with higher education institutions in ethnic regions, and focus on solving the shortage of personnel in basic-level people's courts in western ethnic regions. Promote the implementation of the system for the recruitment and training of judicial police in people's courts, and further strengthen the construction of the judicial police team in people's courts. Promote the implementation of the Opinions on the Construction of Information Technology Personnel Teams in People's Courts and the Reform Plan for the Management System of Employed Clerks in People's Courts and People's Procuratorates (Trial), and strengthen the construction of information technology personnel and employed clerk teams in people's courts.

3. Increase the recruitment intensity for judge assistants in basic-level people's courts. Actively implement the Opinions on Recruiting Judge Assistants for People's Courts and Prosecutor Assistants for People's Procuratorates, while adhering to standardized recruitment and strict checks, allow city and county level courts to adopt special recruitment policies such as separate declaration of recruitment plans, separate organization of exams, and separate setting of written examination pass lines when recruiting judge assistants, further increasing policy support for hard and remote areas.

(6) Strengthen Basic-Level Team Management and Occupational Security

1. Adhere to strict governance of the team. Strengthen the management and supervision of basic-level court personnel, adhere to a cadre supervision and management mechanism that combines strict management with care, and constraints with incentives, promote the deep integration of cadre supervision and management with grassroots Party building and personnel selection and appointment, and build a clean and upright basic-level people's court cadre team. Give full play to the management and supervision function of cadre assessment, combine daily assessment with periodic assessment, increase the intensity of accountability and organizational adjustment for cadres who lack responsibility and initiative, and achieve regularization, institutionalization, and full coverage of assessment work.

2. Earnestly implement the reform of the separate rank sequence for judges. Implement the reform of the separate rank sequence for judges, build a judge management model that conforms to the laws of trial work, accelerate the work of periodic promotions and selective promotions of judge ranks, make full use of policies tilted towards the grassroots level, and promote the implementation of policies such as the specifications, ratio settings, and promotion methods of judge ranks.

3. Fully implement the reform of the salary system for basic-level judges. Fully implement the supporting salary policies for the separate rank sequence for judges, promptly disburse performance appraisal bonuses for quota judges, trial support personnel, and judicial administrative personnel. Earnestly implement policies such as corresponding rank treatment when judges are transferred or rotated, the retirement age policy for female judges, judge medical care, official transportation subsidies, and travel treatment, and actively coordinate to solve policies such as judge housing. Quickly implement occupational security policies such as judicial police rank allowance, duty post allowance, and overtime allowance for people's courts.

(7) Strengthen the Construction of People's Tribunals

1. Optimize the setting of people's tribunals. In conjunction with the needs of trial work and the reform of internal court institutions, further optimize the layout of people's tribunals, on the basis of giving full play to the traditional functions of people's tribunals, actively promote the construction of typed, specialized trials and comprehensive courts, and better play the role of people's tribunals as windows rooted in the grassroots and facing the masses. Accelerate the construction of "smart courts," actively promote the construction of an "online data integration processing platform" for specialized and typed disputes, and effectively improve the efficiency of dispute resolution.

2. Strengthen the staffing of people's tribunals. Adapt to the needs of trial work in people's tribunals, and fully equip court staff. The president of a people's tribunal should be a judge with excellent political quality, high professional level, strong coordination ability, and trial work experience, and truly make the people's tribunal an important base for cultivating, training, and selecting court leading cadres and business backbones.

3. Improve the level of support for people's tribunals. Establish a work system for leading cadres at all levels to go to people's tribunals for蹲点 (stationing at grass-roots units), promptly discover and coordinate to solve existing difficulties and problems. Improve the working conditions of people's tribunals, strengthen the modernization of office and case handling and informatization construction in people's tribunals, strengthen professional training for court personnel in people's tribunals, and effectively improve the judicial level and work efficiency of people's tribunals. Enrich the cultural life of court personnel, care about the physical and mental health and family difficulties of court personnel in tribunals, and enable them to devote themselves fully and happily to their work.

III. Key Work Tasks and Objectives for 2018

(1) Promote the reform of internal institutions in courts below the provincial level. In accordance with the requirements of the Notice on Actively Promoting the Reform of Internal Institutions in People's Courts Below the Provincial Level, adhere to the principle of optimization, synergy, and efficiency, on the basis of rationalizing functions and optimizing division of labor, set up internal institutions in a streamlined and standardized manner. All basic-level people's courts and high and intermediate people's courts carrying out internal institution reform should form a reform plan for internal institutions before the end of 2018, complete the approval procedures, report to the Supreme People's Court for record, and basically complete the task of internal institution reform by March 2019.

(2) Accelerate the construction of trial and enforcement teams. Rationally allocate trial support personnel, combine factors such as case volume, trial level, and team structure, establish scientific and reasonable trial and enforcement teams, clarify division of responsibilities, and improve performance assessment.

(3) Promote the construction of specialized and information-based courts. On the basis of giving full play to the traditional functions of people's tribunals, according to the composition of court cases and litigation needs, in economically developed, high case volume, and conveniently accessible urban areas, focus on building a number of specialized courts such as family trial, labor dispute, road traffic accident, tourism dispute, and intellectual property, to improve the trial quality and efficiency of typed cases. Promote the construction and application of informatization such as remote case filing, voice query, online case handling, electronic signatures, and remote video testimony, strengthen the intelligentization, scientific management, and real-time supervision of case handling in people's tribunals, actively build a "open, dynamic, transparent, and convenient" sunshine judicial platform, and provide sufficient technical support and technical guarantee for the convenience and efficient justice of people's tribunals.

(4) Eliminate low-level errors in adjudicative documents. Earnestly implement the Urgent Notice on Comprehensively Improving the Quality of Adjudicative Documents and Effectively Preventing the Repeated Occurrence of Low-level Errors, popularize the installation of document intelligent error correction software, and improve and perfect the adjudicative document verification and quality management mechanism. Solidly carry out the quality evaluation work of adjudicative documents published online in 2018, striving to evaluate more than 300,000 adjudicative documents. Timely report prominent issues found, and supervise and promote rectification; for issues that cause a bad social impact, not only should the direct responsible person be seriously held accountable, but also the court leadership responsibility should be pursued, striving to significantly improve the image of basic-level people's courts and judges.

(5) Fully implement the salary and treatment of judges. Strictly in accordance with the requirements of the Pilot Plan for the Salary System Reform for Judges and Prosecutors and the Implementation Measures for the Salary System Reform for Judges, Prosecutors, and Judicial Support Personnel (Trial), increase the promotion and implementation efforts, strive to ensure that by the end of the year, all people's courts at all levels nationwide can implement the central reform policy according to the separate rank sequence of judges, and promptly disburse performance appraisal bonuses.

(6) Addressing the Shortage of Bilingual Judges in Some Regions. The Supreme People's Court, together with the State Ethnic Affairs Commission, jointly organized demonstration training classes for bilingual judges in the Uygur-Chinese and Tibetan-Chinese languages. It instructed relevant High People's Courts to conduct further categorized and tiered bilingual judge training, aiming to train approximately 1,500 bilingual judges. Ten bilingual legal textbooks and supplementary readers were published. Pursuant to the "Measures for Appraising Bilingual Judges in Minority Areas (in Chinese and Minority Languages)", the first batch of bilingual judge appraisals was conducted, assessing over 800 bilingual judges, ensuring that courts in ethnic minority regions with a high volume of bilingual cases have three to four expert-level judges who are proficient in both adjudication and the use of the national common language and script as well as the local minority language and script.

4. Implementation

(1) High Priority and Clear Responsibility. Strengthening the grassroots foundation for the people's court contingent is an important measure to implement the spirit of the National People's Congress and the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, and to forge a competent grassroots contingent that meets the development needs of the people's courts in the new era. The Party leadership groups of people's courts at all levels nationwide must attach high importance, effectively assume leadership responsibility, hold special meetings to study and deploy, and coordinate the implementation. The political departments of people's courts at all levels nationwide must, under the leadership of the Party leadership group, effectively perform their supervisory functions, take the lead in organizing implementation, and steadily push forward the work. Relevant departments within people's courts at all levels nationwide must fully leverage their functional roles, strengthen coordination and cooperation, and work together to ensure implementation according to their responsibilities.

(2) Careful Organization and Enhanced Supervision. Courts in all regions must, in accordance with the requirements of the implementation plan, make thorough arrangements, carefully organize, study and formulate work plans, establish work ledgers and a supervision and implementation mechanism, and earnestly ensure that all specific tasks are implemented. High People's Courts must regularly conduct in-depth grassroots research to understand the implementation status of the plan, coordinate to resolve problems and difficulties encountered during implementation, and supervise the courts within their jurisdiction to implement tasks according to plan. The Supreme People's Court will, at appropriate times, adopt forms such as special inspections, random checks, information bulletins, and experience exchanges to strengthen supervision and inspection of the grassroots foundation work of courts in all regions.

(3) Publicity and Atmosphere Creation. People's courts at all levels nationwide must promptly review and summarize the important measures, major progress, typical experiences, and actual results of strengthening grassroots foundation work. They should fully utilize mainstream media, especially new media, both within and outside the court system, to carry out multi-level publicity and reporting, strive to promote distinctive and effective experiences and practices, and create a favorable public opinion atmosphere.
